Back to home ↗
01 /

I have not received my email code

Check that your email is correct, then look in your inbox and spam folder. Codes expire after 10 minutes. Wait 60 seconds before resending; only the latest code works. After five incorrect attempts, request a new code. Never share a verification code.

02 /

My deposit is still pending

A manual deposit needs administrator verification of the external payment. Check the payment method instructions and your reference. A Stripe return page alone does not confirm payment; your wallet updates after payment confirmation.

Payment questions ↗
03 /

My copy chart has not changed

Only settled games change the performance chart. Pending picks remain listed without changing the chart. Check that your position is active for future picks; paused positions still settle existing games.

04 /

I cannot request a withdrawal

Check your KYC approval, available wallet funds, the withdrawal minimum and the available payment methods. Funds in copy positions or pending stakes must become available before you can use them.

Verification steps ↗
05 /

I need to speak with someone

Sign in and open the support chat. Choose Talk to admin for a handover. Include the relevant request or stake reference and explain what happened. Replies appear in the same private conversation.

Contact support ↗

A FEW MORE ANSWERS.

Can support change the result of a game?+

The support assistant cannot settle stakes, change scores or move money. An administrator can review a reported issue through the support inbox.

Does creating an account give me free funds?+

No. New accounts start at zero. Deposits need payment confirmation or manual verification. A promotional credit requires a valid, unused administrator-issued code.

Are arcade games available for paid staking?+

The arcade titles are previews. Monetary staking is available only for the sports events published on the platform.
